recap.text: Langley leads a six-man team of archers who sold cars in Helsinki. He reaches level 32 and considers offers from Katia and others. The Popov brothers want his team to hunt team Cichociemni. Princess Donut notes every crawler in their quadrant survived the floor.

Crawler Langley and his team are eliminated while hunting Bogdon Ro. Katia shares the news in the chat. Langley's head is mounted on Hunter Vrah's shoulder as a trophy. Princess Donut casts Second Chance on the heads, and Langley bites Vrah in the neck.

beats.headline: A team of car salesmen with bows
beats.text: Subject leads a six-man team of archers, all of whom sold cars in Helsinki and all of whom picked the Archer Class together, which is either loyalty or a failure of imagination and has worked out the same either way. They come into the fifth floor as strangers to the court and do not stay strangers.
beats.gist: Langley leads six Helsinki car salesmen who picked the Archer Class together and enter the fifth floor.

beats.headline: Off to break up the killers
beats.text: Crawler Langley, level 32, eight levels up since he met Crawler Carl. His team leaves the bowl ahead of the last stage. Katia offered them a place with her new team; he is considering others. The Popov brothers want archers to hunt team Cichociemni, who have been preying on weak crawlers, and the player-killer groups need breaking up before they get too strong. Handshakes. Princess Donut notes that every crawler in their own quadrant made it through the floor alive.
beats.gist: Level 32 Crawler Langley considers offers to join teams and help the Popov brothers hunt team Cichociemni.

beats.headline: His whole team, hunting a top ten
beats.text: A champion has fallen, and a hunter has claimed a bounty. Crawler Langley and every member of his team have been eliminated on the sixth floor. They were not on the top ten. They were hunting a man who was, Bogdon Ro, with a large group, and had him cornered. Whatever happened next killed all of them, and a hunter took the credit. Immigrants to Finland, according to Crawler Carl, who had not said a word to him since the floor began. Katia broke the news in the chat. The orc at Carl's feet says it shows how dangerous Vrah is.
beats.gist: Langley and his team are eliminated on the sixth floor while hunting Bogdon Ro.

beats.headline: His head bites Vrah
beats.text: Crawler Langley's head is mounted on Hunter Vrah's shoulder, beside Bogdon Ro's, among the trophies she wears on her back. Princess Donut, invisible, has cast Second Chance on as many of them as her mana allows. Carl tells Langley he is sorry he could not help him before, and that he appreciates his help now. Vrah says "What?" as the head bites into her exposed neck and holds. Bogdon Ro bites from the other side. Then a third.
beats.gist: Langley's head bites Hunter Vrah's neck while Donut casts Second Chance on the trophies.
